observations: Photo 0 shows the top of a silver and black camera with 'Nikon' and 'Z fc' visible on the body.
Photo 1 shows the front of the camera with a lens attached, labeled '25mm 1:2.0' and 'Nikon Z 50mm f/2.8 S'.
Photo 2 shows the camera with a battery, battery charger, and two lens caps, one labeled 'TTArtisan 18-55mm f/2.8' and the other 'Nikon Z mount'.
The camera appears to be a mirrorless camera with a retro design, consistent with the 'retro-inspired, slr-style mirrorless camera' description.
The lens is a 25mm f/2.8, which is a common kit lens for this model.
The battery is labeled 'Nikon Z 5000mAh', which is a standard battery for this model.
The charger is labeled 'Nikon Battery Charger', matching the camera's branding.

claims.claim: Nikon Z fc is a retro-inspired, slr-style mirrorless camera featuring a 20.9-megapixel aps-c...
claims.evidence: The model 'Z fc' is visible in photo 0, and the design is retro-inspired. The 20.9-megapixel APS-C sensor is not visible in any photo, but is a known specification for this model. The 'slr-style mirrorless camera' description is subjective and not verifiable from the photos.

risks.risk: The camera may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on the screen.

risks.risk: The lens may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass and internal elements, or a video showing the lens focusing and aperture changing.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or not hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the battery charging and powering the camera for at least 30 seconds.

risks.risk: The charger may not work or may be missing a cable.
risks.proof: A video showing the charger connecting to the camera and charging it.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up of the lens glass and internal elements.
Video of the battery charging and powering the camera.
Video of the charger connecting to the camera and charging it.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
